review_scope: Independent local code and fixture review only; no remote invocation, artifact collection, SSH, provider call, training, GPU, or checkpoint deserialization.

retry_and_parent_binding.result: Exact wide recovery attempt v2, original F1 plan/contract and trainer command, and V2 stage1 parent are bound. The stage1 receipt and dependency identities are checked against the actual local receipt fixture; B paths resolve to runtime/receipts.

producer_schema_checks.result: Collector validates exact provenance counters, per-epoch diagnostics, resume pointer and model hash against producer provenance. It captures attempt JSON bytes once and parses/hashes the same bytes. Source hashes/stats are pinned before validation, required during copy, and copied artifacts are checked against those hashes.

resource_and_output_checks.collector_quota: at most 25% CPU, 512000000 bytes, zero swap, RuntimeMaxUSec=2min
resource_and_output_checks.parent_headroom: memory.current + 8000000000 worker reserve + 512000000 collector reserve <= min(memory.max, 17000000000); campaign-slice swap must be zero

mandatory_outer_gate: The helper internally checks model_ep2.pt against its contemporaneous producer provenance, but does not hardcode the independently observed model SHA. Before launch, root must require the live model SHA to equal ce9d6e0623ce51de179a95a6defc1222d20a9a62b2890b364cdf6b491de08fdd and after collection require the copied model SHA to equal that same value.
limitations: The collector does not deserialize training_state.pt; next_epoch=3, optimizer tensors, tensor finiteness and measured resume parity remain for the structural verifier.

The reviewed code does not itself set or inspect CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES or TMPDIR. The outer launcher must hide CUDA and set TMPDIR to physical B/research_tmp, with the parent resource and mount preflight recorded separately.
No actual epoch-2 artifact bytes were collected or inspected during this review; no quality or training claim follows.
